note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) English species-level description; the original describes only the soldier, records the alate as Not known, and does not describe the worker. OCR problems: the title line reads 'Ham itermes (Homitermes ) modicus'; 'Pig.' is an error for Fig.; 'sth' is an error for 5th; head length (to apex of labrum) in the original reads '1.50 - I.', the second value being incomplete in the OCR, so that measurement is not entered and awaits verification. Type locality New South Wales: Griffith, consistent with the checklist. Distribution and biology are not translated into the morphology sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: It differs from A. xylophagus in the head being more narrowed anteriorly and the antennae usually with one segment fewer; from A. neogermanus in the much shorter head and the also shorter mandibles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Not recorded in the original (Not known).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: A small species; head pale yellow; mandibles short and stout, with a hook-like tooth near the middle. Head rather long and deep, the sides slightly rounded, widest at the middle, the posterior part broadly rounded, with few but rather long hairs. Postmentum wide (0.33). Mandibles strongly curved, the tooth almost on the same line as the apex of the labrum, the basal third orange-yellow, the apical two-thirds rusty. Labrum obtusely conical, slightly shorter than its basal width. Antennae usually 14-segmented; segment 4 shortest; in 15-segmented antennae segment 3 is very short and closely fused with segment 4; segment 5 about as long as segment 4. Measurements: total length 4.25—4.60 mm, head length (including mandibles) 1.68—1.83 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.06—1.13 mm, head width 0.99—1.06 mm, pronotum length 0.29—0.31 mm, width 0.64—0.73 mm.
